mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.user_id AS "userId", i.doc_type AS "docType", i.doc_no AS "docNo", i.source_quote_id AS "sourceQuoteId", i.title, i.content::text AS content, i.supply_amount AS "supplyAmount", i.vat_amount AS "vatAmount", i.total_amount AS "totalAmount", i.paid, i.deleted, i.created_at AS "createdAt", i.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM invoice i WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.deleted = FALSE FOR SHARE
